title: acleisanthes purpusiana var. marshii
intro: Acleisanthes purpusiana var. marshii, commonly known as Marsh's Acleisanthes, is a plant species that belongs to the family of loasa plants. It is used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in relieving coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Marsh's Acleisanthes include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and potential risks.
